about: Wise Group plc provides cross-border and domestic financial services in the United Kingdom, the rest of Europe, the Asia-Pacific, North America, and internationally. It offers money transfers, currency conversions, and account services. The company's products include Wise Account, a solution for individual customers to send, spend, hold, and get paid in one or more currencies; Wise Business, which offers the main features of the Wise Account product along with business-specific functionalities designed to enable businesses to operate internationally, including managing their accounting and accounts payable and receivables; and Wise Platform, which enables banks, financial institutions, and enterprises to integrate into a global payment infrastructure, allowing institutional partners to send and receive payments. Wise Group plc was founded in 2010 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
